name: Earned Organic Mentions
kicker: Earned organic — a strength, not a gap
definition: Product, packaging, and experience are so distinctive that creators tag, mention, and post without compensation.

name: UGC for Brand Feed
definition: Pay UGC creators to deliver vertical video the brand publishes on its OWN feed — not as paid ads, not on the creator's channel.

name: Always-On Creator Retainers
definition: Pay a roster of creators a monthly fee to post about the brand on their own audience, every month, for 6-12+ months.

name: Press & Brand Trips
definition: Host a tight cluster of creators at a venue or destination — typically 8-30 creators inside a 3-7 day window, with content seeded across their channels.

name: Long-Term Brand Ambassador
definition: Contract 1-3 high-trust creators as multi-year ambassadors with annual fees, events, and product input.

name: UGC for Paid Ads
definition: License creator-shot vertical video and run it as paid ads on Meta and TikTok — high creative velocity, low CPA.

name: Affiliate / Commission Programmes
definition: Open a permanent commission-only programme — any creator can apply, brand pays only on attributed sale.

name: Creator Collective / Volume Model
definition: 20-100+ small creators each posting multiple short-form videos a day about the brand on their own channels.

name: Alt-Handle / Brand-Affiliated Creator Channel
definition: A single creator whose tagged-post output is dominated by one niche brand — store staff, a paid resident creator, or a quasi-brand-controlled affiliate handle.

name: High-Value Gifting & Seeding
definition: Send premium-packaged product to 20-200+ micro creators with a soft ask to post if they enjoy it.

name: Creator-Led Drops & Collabs
definition: Co-create a limited-edition SKU or collab with a creator and market the drop as a timed media event.

name: Geo-Clustered Micro-Creators
definition: Activate 20-50 micro creators per metro / per venue, with captions that name the city, the neighbourhood, the store.

name: Burner & Volume Posting Networks
definition: Coordinate many small-follower accounts to tag the brand with near-identical caption templates — bulk, low-cost surface area.

name: TikTok-Shop Affiliate Programme
definition: Open the brand on TikTok Shop and let affiliate creators run shoppable content — captions that read 'tap to shop', 'linked below', 'use my code'.

name: Influencer-Hosted IRL Events
definition: A single moment — launch party, opening night, preview — with 6+ creators tagging the brand inside a 3-day window and explicitly naming the event.

name: Live Shopping with Creator Hosts
definition: Real-time selling on TikTok Live or IG Live — creators host scheduled live drops and drive conversion in-app.
